content_zh:
“你完了，小子。”赵建飞冷冷地道。
金浩山额头的汗水淋漓，他抬眼看着赵建飞，极力掩饰着自己的恐惧，“赵教官，你再给我一次机会。”
“许多人都可以有第二次机会，但是你不会有，因为你是一个背叛者。”赵建飞平静地道，“我们确实是在为利益而战，但是并不是为了利益就可以出卖同伴。战士为国而战，他们光荣、崇高，他们的勇气可以得到赞许。但是这一切和佣兵没有关系，我们佣兵什么都没有，除了我们彼此，什么都没有。”
“赵教官……”金浩山的声音有一些颤抖，他似乎从赵建飞平静的语气之中听出了某种危险。
“没用了。你已经无法留在团队之中，因为这里所有人都无法再信任你了。没有人希望在作战的时候还要留意身边战友的黑枪。而再好的士兵，也不可能独自作战。你已经out了，出局了。”赵建飞淡淡地一笑道，“我可以忍受你一直想逃跑的想法，也可以容忍你这样的老鼠在军火库周围转悠。毕竟你还没有做出什么实际危害到大家的事情。但是这一次，是你自己作死。”
赵建飞打了一个响指，立刻来了几个全副武装的基地守卫，把瘫软在地上的金浩山拖了出去。
所有佣兵学员都震惊地看着这一切。他们不知道金浩山将要面临什么，也没有人敢问。
赵建飞缓缓转过身，对所有佣兵学员道，“这个人已经没有资格再留在这里了。我希望这是有用的一课，你们都给我的利益得到保障，你们个人才有利益。之所以这样佣兵才是佣兵，而不是有组织无纪律的暴徒。所有人继续训练。”
赵建飞的这一枪足足让林锐在床上躺了两天，而他胸口被橡皮子弹射出大片青肿不知道什么时候才能消退。而两天之后他又被强行拖出去训练，直到累得像一条狗一样喘息。整个训练营之中没有人再见过金浩山，也没有人再提起这个人。似乎所有人都心照不宣地回避和这个人有关的一切。
第五小队，现在只剩下了五个人，但训练强度却丝毫没有减轻。很多时候，林锐等人不得不以五个人来完成原本六人小队完成的训练。训练营的空气始终处在一种压迫感之下，林锐不知道这种压迫感从何而来，但是他知道，不久之后一定会有事情要发生。
训练营的结构是老式的苏联军事基地，分为两层，上层是几位教官所在的地方，而一般的佣兵学员则在下层。林锐所在的宿舍是在靠近教官居所的上下层结合部位。
金浩山离开了，生死不明。在这个房间里只剩下了林锐和秦奋，两个人又是一个小队的成员。所以关系要比一般学员要近一些。
秦奋坐在靠墙的地方，神情有些迷惘。
林锐却依然保持着沉默，他很少说话，但是他所说的话通常就是结论。秦奋则是一个话多的人，难得安静下来。所以很少看到他这样沉默，他不说话，林锐也没有问。
最终开口的还是秦奋，他转过头看着林锐道，“兄弟，有烟么？”
“香烟？你觉得最近的超市离我们这里有多远？”林锐看着他道。”怎么突然想抽烟了，你似乎没有什么烟瘾。”
秦奋有些无精打采地道，“就是想抽而已。”
“老金的床铺底下藏了半包烟，是他偷偷摸摸带进来的，我见他抽过一次。你去拿吧，反正他也用不着了。”林锐低声道。
秦奋翻出了那包皱巴巴的香烟，拿出了两支已经有些折弯了烟卷，随手扔给了林锐一支。林锐接住了香烟，却阻止了正准备点烟的秦奋。
秦奋愣了一下，林锐却对他指了指天花板，低声道，“别在这里抽，有烟雾报警，去外面走廊吧。”

秦奋和林锐一起走到了寝室外的走廊上，点起了烟沉默地抽着。不知道是不是太久没有抽烟了，又或者是这香烟让他想起了金浩山，林锐觉得香烟的味道有些辛辣，才抽了两口，他甚至觉得头点发晕。
“呸，这烟似乎放太久了，味道不太对。”秦奋吐了一口，有些皱眉道。
“嘘。”林锐低声道，“别说话，似乎有人。”

content_en:
"You're done, kid." Zhao Jianfei said coldly.
Jin Haoshan's forehead was dripping with sweat. He looked up at Zhao Jianfei and tried his best to hide his fear, "Instructor Zhao, give me another chance."
"Many people can have a second chance, but you won't, because you are a betrayer." Zhao Jianfei said calmly, "We are indeed fighting for interests, but we do not betray our companions just for the sake of interests. Soldiers fight for the country, they are glorious and noble, and their courage can be praised. But all this has nothing to do with mercenaries. We mercenaries have nothing, except each other, we have nothing."
"Instructor Zhao..." Jin Haoshan's voice trembled a little, and he seemed to hear some danger from Zhao Jianfei's calm tone.
"It's useless. You can no longer stay in the team, because no one here can trust you anymore. No one wants to pay attention to the black guns of their comrades during the battle. And no matter how good a soldier is, it is impossible to fight alone. You are out, out." Zhao Jianfei said with a faint smile, "I can tolerate your thoughts of always wanting to escape, and I can tolerate a rat like you wandering around the arsenal. After all, you haven't done anything that actually harms everyone. But this time, you are seeking your own death."
Zhao Jianfei snapped his fingers, and several heavily armed base guards immediately came and dragged Jin Haoshan out, who was lying limp on the ground.
All the mercenary students looked at all this in shock. They didn't know what Jin Haoshan was going to face, and no one dared to ask.
Zhao Jianfei slowly turned around and said to all the mercenary students, "This person is no longer qualified to stay here. I hope this is a useful lesson. The interests you have given me are protected, and only you have interests. This is why mercenaries are mercenaries, not organized and undisciplined thugs. Everyone continue training."
Zhao Jianfei's shot caused Lin Rui to lie in bed for two days, and he didn't know when the large bruises on his chest from the rubber bullets would subside. Two days later, he was forcibly dragged out for training until he was so tired that he panted like a dog. No one in the entire training camp saw Jin Haoshan again, and no one mentioned this person again. Everyone seemed to tacitly avoid anything related to this person.
There are only five people left in the fifth team, but the training intensity has not decreased at all. Many times, Lin Rui and others had to use five people to complete the training that was originally completed by the six-person team. The air in the training camp was always under a sense of oppression. Lin Rui didn't know where this sense of oppression came from, but he knew that something would happen soon.
The structure of the training camp is an old Soviet military base, divided into two floors. The upper floor is where several instructors are located, while the general mercenary trainees are on the lower floor. Lin Rui's dormitory is at the junction of the upper and lower floors near the instructor's residence.
Jin Haoshan left, his life and death unknown. Only Lin Rui and Qin Fen were left in this room, and they were members of the same team. Therefore, the relationship is closer than that of ordinary students.
Qin Fen sat against the wall, looking a little confused.
Lin Rui remained silent. He rarely spoke, but what he said was usually the conclusion. Qin Fen is a talkative person and rarely gets quiet. So it's rare to see him so silent. He didn't speak, and Lin Rui didn't ask.
It was Qin Fen who finally spoke. He turned his head and looked at Lin Rui and said, "Brother, do you have any cigarettes?"
"Cigarettes? How far do you think the nearest supermarket is from us?" Lin Rui looked at him and asked. "Why do you suddenly want to smoke? You don't seem to have any craving for cigarettes."
Qin Fen said listlessly, "I just want to smoke."
"There is half a pack of cigarettes hidden under Lao Jin's bed. He brought it in secretly. I saw him smoke it once. Go get it. Anyway, he alsoNo need for it. Lin Rui whispered.
Qin Fen dug out the crumpled pack of cigarettes, took out two bent cigarettes, and threw one to Lin Rui. Lin Rui caught the cigarette, but stopped Qin Fen who was about to light a cigarette.
Qin Fen was stunned for a moment, but Lin Rui pointed to him at the ceiling and whispered, "Don't smoke here, there is a smoke alarm, go to the corridor outside. "
Qin Fen and Lin Rui walked to the corridor outside the dormitory together, lit up cigarettes and smoked silently. He didn't know if he hadn't smoked for a long time, or if the cigarette reminded him of Jin Haoshan. Lin Rui felt that the smell of the cigarette was a bit spicy, so he took two puffs. He even felt dizzy.
“Bah, this cigarette seems to have been left out for too long and the taste is not right. "Qin Fen spit out a mouthful and said with a slight frown.
"Shhh. Lin Rui whispered, "Stop talking, there seems to be someone." "
